mentions.name: 20 Games Challenge (Godot learning project)
mentions.description: A personal game development learning project working through the 20 Games Challenge in the Godot engine, building a list of 20 games to gain experience; Flappy Bird (the 2nd challenge) is nearly complete. The long-term aim is to recreate classic arcade and Game Boy games and to build explorable, simulated worlds featuring mechanical systems and space rovers.
